title: SHAP for Explainable Machine Learning
description: We’re often interested in understanding how machine learning models make predictions, but this is not always easy with complex models. The goal of SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) is to explain the prediction of an instance x by computing the contribution of each feature to the prediction. In this talk, we will discuss the topic of transparency in Machine Learning through the lenses of SHAP, the benefits and limitations of this method and practical applications in a business context.
